_comment: The director's fixed menu. Every shot in a plan picks from these ids; the checker refuses anything else. `words` is how a prompt says it; `hailuo` is MiniMax Hailuo's bracket command where one exists. The craft behind each entry is in skills/motion-design/references/director/craft.md.

sizes.label: Extreme wide
sizes.when: Show the whole world and how small the subject is in it; opens a film or a new place.

sizes.label: Wide
sizes.when: Establish the place and where everyone is before going closer.

sizes.label: Full
sizes.when: The whole body, head to toe; movement, posture and costume.

sizes.label: Medium wide
sizes.when: Knees up; a person and what their hands and surroundings are doing.

sizes.label: Medium
sizes.when: Waist up; the neutral conversational shot.

sizes.label: Medium close-up
sizes.when: Chest up; reactions while keeping a little context.

sizes.label: Close-up
sizes.when: The face or the object fills the frame; emotion and decisions.

sizes.label: Extreme close-up
sizes.when: An eye, a fingertip, a texture; maximum intensity, used sparingly.

sizes.label: Insert
sizes.when: A detail the viewer must read: a screen, a button, a label.

angles.label: High
angles.when: Looking down makes the subject smaller or overwhelmed.

angles.label: Low
angles.when: Looking up makes the subject powerful or heroic.

angles.label: Overhead
angles.when: Straight down; desks, layouts, screens treated as graphics.

angles.label: Worm's eye
angles.when: From the floor; scale and drama.

angles.label: Dutch
angles.when: A tilted horizon for unease or energy; rarely, never twice in a row.

angles.label: Over the shoulder
angles.when: Past one person to another person or a screen; puts the viewer in the scene.

lenses.label: 14mm ultra-wide
lenses.when: Exaggerated space for tight interiors and energy; never on a face up close.

lenses.label: 24mm wide
lenses.when: Roomy and close at once; establishing shots and moving through space.

lenses.label: 35mm
lenses.when: Natural and documentary; the storyteller's all-rounder.

lenses.label: 50mm
lenses.when: Close to how the eye sees; honest medium shots.

lenses.label: 85mm portrait
lenses.when: Flatters faces and melts the background; close-ups.

lenses.label: 135mm telephoto
lenses.when: Compresses the background and isolates; watching from afar.

lenses.label: 100mm macro
lenses.when: Tiny details large and sharp; textures, product surfaces, UI pixels.

lensLooks.label: Clean spherical
lensLooks.when: A clean modern look with round bokeh.

lensLooks.label: Anamorphic
lensLooks.when: A cinematic widescreen feel with oval bokeh and horizontal flares.

depths.label: Shallow (f/1.4-2)
depths.when: One plane sharp, the rest soft; isolates the subject.

depths.label: Deep (f/8-11)
depths.when: Everything sharp; wide shots and graphic layouts.

moves.label: Static
moves.when: Let the action or the composition do the work.

moves.label: Push in
moves.when: Move toward the subject to build attention or a realisation.

moves.label: Pull out
moves.when: Move away to reveal context or close a scene.

moves.label: Pan left
moves.when: Turn on the spot to follow or reveal sideways.

moves.label: Pan right
moves.when: Turn on the spot to follow or reveal sideways.

moves.label: Tilt up
moves.when: Reveal height or lift the mood.

moves.label: Tilt down
moves.when: Bring the eye down to what matters.

moves.label: Truck left
moves.when: Slide sideways alongside the action for parallax.

moves.label: Truck right
moves.when: Slide sideways alongside the action for parallax.

moves.label: Pedestal up
moves.when: Lift without tilting to reveal over an object.

moves.label: Pedestal down
moves.when: Sink without tilting to land on a detail.

moves.label: Follow
moves.when: Stay with a moving subject at a constant distance.

moves.label: Orbit left
moves.when: Circle the subject to show it in the round; keep the arc under 45 degrees.

moves.label: Orbit right
moves.when: Circle the subject to show it in the round; keep the arc under 45 degrees.

moves.label: Crane up
moves.words: cranes up and over the scene
moves.when: A big rising move for openings and endings.

moves.label: Crane down
moves.when: Descend into the scene from above.

moves.label: Handheld
moves.words: moves handheld with a slight natural shake
moves.when: Immediacy: creator footage, documentary.

moves.label: Zoom in
moves.when: Magnify without moving; a flat, deliberate emphasis.

moves.label: Zoom out
moves.when: Shrink the view without moving.

moves.label: Rack focus
moves.words: racks focus from the foreground to the background
moves.when: Shift attention between two planes without moving.

speeds.label: Fast
speeds.when: Energy and urgency; needs room, so not in short shots.

lights.label: Soft high key
lights.when: Bright and friendly with little shadow; tech and lifestyle.

lights.label: Low key
lights.words: moody low-key light with deep shadows

lights.label: Rembrandt
lights.words: Rembrandt lighting with a triangle of light on the shadow cheek

lights.label: Backlit rim
lights.words: backlight that rims the subject in light
lights.when: Separates the subject from the background; silhouettes and hair light.

lights.label: Night with practicals
lights.words: night scene lit by practical lamps and screens
lights.when: Lamps, signs and screens in frame are the light.

lights.label: Studio product
lights.words: studio product lighting with a large softbox and a rim light
lights.when: Clean reflections and crisp edges on products.

lights.label: Overcast natural
lights.when: Natural and gentle with no hard shadows.

cuts.label: Cut on action
cuts.when: Cut mid-movement so the motion hides the edit.

cuts.label: Match cut
cuts.when: A shape or motion here matches one in the next shot.

cuts.label: Whip pan
cuts.when: A fast blur carries the energy into the next shot.

cuts.label: Dissolve
cuts.when: Time passes, or a soft change of mood.

cuts.label: Continuous
cuts.when: The next shot starts on this shot's last frame: one unbroken moment.

keyLightSides.label: Front
keyLightSides.when: Flat and even; graphics and beauty.

keyLightSides.label: Top
keyLightSides.when: Overhead light; product tables and drama.

jobs.label: Motion graphics
jobs.when: Type, UI and abstract graphic motion.

jobs.label: Cinematic
jobs.when: Live-action-looking scenes with people and places.

jobs.label: Working from reference images
jobs.when: A Library character or product must match its sheet.

jobs.label: Lip sync
jobs.when: Someone speaks a line on camera.

jobs.label: Product hero
jobs.when: Physical products on turntables, in macro and under light sweeps.

filmTypes.label: Product ad with UI
filmTypes.when: App screens, a mascot, kinetic type and an end card.

filmTypes.label: Character animation
filmTypes.when: Stylised or 3D characters acting out a short story.

filmTypes.label: Product hero
filmTypes.when: A physical product shown at its best.
